description: Finds every parcel within a radius of a point, nearest first. Costs 3 credits per request, however many parcels come back. Radius up to 5,000 metres. Up to 1,000 parcels per request. Needs an API key. Lookups in counties we do not cover and failed requests cost no credits. Returns parcel records with WKT boundaries in EPSG:4326, owner, address, assessed values, land use and zoning where the county publishes them.
